CustomField.description: Evaluates whether this tier is currently active, has seats available, and is within the sales window.
CustomField.formula: AND( Is_Active__c, Available__c > 0, OR(ISBLANK(Sales_Open_At__c), Sales_Open_At__c <= NOW()), OR(ISBLANK(Sales_Close_At__c), Sales_Close_At__c >= NOW()) )
CustomField.label: Is Sellable
